basic_details.job_title: Family Court Nalbari Sweeping and Cleaning Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Family Court Nalbari has notified 1 temporary vacancy for Services of Sweeping and Cleaning under advertisement number FC.NLB/36/2026/755-757. Eligible applicants can apply offline by submitting a sealed quotation by hand or post to the Office of the Principal Judge, Family Court, Nalbari. The application process starts on 5 October 2026, and the last date to submit the application is 14 October 2026. The engagement is valid for a period of 01 (One) year from the date of selection of bidder, with pay on a Monthly Basis based on rates quoted by the bidder and finalized after approval.

qualification.details: Nature of Work: Maintaining cleanliness and hygiene in the Court campus and building as well as the official residence of Judicial Officers quarters, any housekeeping related works, and picking up and disposing of litters. | Specific Terms and Conditions: The work allotment is temporary in nature and valid for a period of 01 (One) year from the date of selection of bidder. The timing of daily work will be within office hours and as per work schedule provided by the establishment. Materials required for the work shall be provided by the establishment.

selection_process: Quotations received will be opened in the presence of intending bidders or their authorized representatives. The rates approved by the office shall be valid for the outsourcing for a period of 01 (One) year from the date of acceptance. Monthly payment shall be made after satisfactory performance of the requisite work

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Intending registered agency, organization, individual persons, or group of individuals must submit sealed quotations affixing a court fee of Rs. 8.25/- (Non-Refundable). The envelope must be duly marked as “Quotation for Services of Sweeping and Cleaning”. Postal and Submission Address: Office of the Principal Judge, Family Court, Nalbari, In front of Medinova Nursing Home, Nalbari, Barama Road, District & P.O.- Nalbari, PIN- 781335, Assam.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Nature of Work: Maintaining cleanliness and hygiene in the Court campus and building as well as the official residence of Judicial Officers quarters, any housekeeping related works, and picking up and disposing of litters. Specific Terms and Conditions: The work allotment is temporary in nature and valid for a period of 01 (One) year from the date of selection of bidder. The timing of daily work will be within office hours and as per work schedule provided by the establishment. Materials required for the work shall be provided by the establishment.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Copy of PAN Card Copy of GST Registration Certificate Copy of Valid registration/Trade license Copy of Experience Certificate if any

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Quotations received will be opened in the presence of intending bidders or their authorized representatives. The rates approved by the office shall be valid for the outsourcing for a period of 01 (One) year from the date of acceptance. Monthly payment shall be made after satisfactory performance of the requisite work, subject to availability of fund.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to submit the quotation for Family Court Nalbari Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to reach the office with the sealed quotation is 14 October 2026 up to 4 P.M.

faq.question: Q2. How long is the engagement valid for the selected bidder?
faq.answer: The work allotment is temporary in nature and valid for a period of 01 (One) year from the date of selection of the bidder, and approved rates are valid for 01 year from the date of acceptance.

faq.question: Q3. What documents must be enclosed with the quotation?
faq.answer: Applicants must enclose a copy of their PAN Card, GST Registration Certificate, Valid registration or Trade license, and an Experience Certificate if any, along with a court fee of Rs. 8.25/-.

faq.question: Q4. Who provides the materials required for sweeping and cleaning work?
faq.answer: Materials required for the work shall be provided by the establishment.
